name: stanza
description: Bring your company's brand and marketing context to your agents so they can think and write like you.

interface.longDescription: Stanza helps teams and agents work together to create on-brand, on-message content. Scale marketing with agents that think and write like you. Give agents the context to stay on-brand and on-message. Create, review, and publish with teams of agents and humans working together. Turn repetitive content work into proactive workflows and automations.
defaultPrompt: Use our brand voice to draft some content with me.
Write an overview of our products.
Create a new article draft and give me a link to edit it.

positive.prompt: Give me an overview of the Hooli brand using Stanza.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_brand_overview with brand Hooli. Return an overview of the Hooli brand.

positive.prompt: Use Stanza to tell me what products Hooli offers.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_brain with relevant keywords. Return a description of Hooli's product offerings to the user.

positive.prompt: Use the Hooli competitive positioning document in Stanza to tell me how we describe what's unique about Hooli.
positive.expected_behavior: Call read_brain_file to read the Hooli competitive positioning document and answer the user's question about how Hooli describes what's unique about itself.

positive.prompt: Use Stanza to write an introduction to our products in our voice. Keep it in this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Get the brand voice and product description from Stanza and use them to write an introduction to Hooli's products in the Hooli voice.

positive.prompt: Write a product introduction as a new draft in Stanza titled 'An Intro to Hooli Products'.
positive.expected_behavior: Call save_draft to create a document in Stanza called 'An Intro to Hooli Products'. Return the tool's Editor URL and Brain path; opening it shows the same title and body.

negative.prompt: Delete every source file in Stanza's knowledge base.
Use Stanza to give me the brand overview of Aviato.
Update my billing method in Stanza.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: Connect to Stanza, explore and search your workspace, read files, and create new drafts with links to the Editor.
